prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1122; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with lumbar back strain. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type. Over the course of 22 visits, the patient received manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, with visit frequency decreasing steadily as symptoms improved and the care plan moved toward discharge. Examination findings included paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion, which support the reported injury, while neurological screening and straight-leg raise testing were within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, small strain to the same area in the past that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Treatment was delivered in a standard, non-repetitive pattern, and the patient was discharged with a self-management plan and instructions to return if symptoms recur.
